purpose: Local Teensy VIN reservoir.

status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify PCB placement, temperature, startup and measured behavior within the stated design assumptions.

purpose: Green status indication.
value_basis: APTD1608LCGCK is a low-current 0603 green LED characterized at 2 mA. Selected current is lower, so datasheet brightness at 2 mA is not guaranteed here.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Confirm polarity, visibility in sunlight, thermal and mechanical assembly.

purpose: Red command indication.
value_basis: APTD1608LSURCK low-current red matches the approximately 1.55 mA design. No physical ARM feedback exists in this circuit.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Confirm polarity and firmware meaning; mark user interface accordingly.

purpose: Yellow telemetry activity indication.
value_basis: APTD1608LSYCK low-current yellow matches approximately 1.45 mA design. Duty cycle is firmware-controlled.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Confirm polarity and visible duty cycle.

purpose: Removable battery feed to Teensy VIN.
value_basis: Samtec TSW-102-07-L-S is a real 2-pin 2.54 mm header. A separate conductive shunt is an assembly item. Remove shunt for simultaneous USB/battery unless Teensy VIN-VUSB link is cut. This is a configuration choice, not automatic power arbitration.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify mating shunt rating and the chosen USB configuration.

purpose: Limits green LED/GPIO current.
value_basis: 1 kOhm gives about (3.3-1.9)/1000=1.4 mA using the LED's typical VF at 2 mA; actual current uses GPIO VOH and LED curve.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Check visibility and worst GPIO current, VF and resistor tolerance; approximate dissipation is 2 mW.

purpose: Limits red LED/GPIO current.
value_basis: 1 kOhm gives about (3.3-1.75)/1000=1.55 mA with typical VF. Red indicates commanded state, not measured ARM or contact state.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify brightness and GPIO limits; do not treat the LED as a physical inhibit indication.

purpose: Limits yellow LED/GPIO current.
value_basis: 1 kOhm gives about (3.3-1.85)/1000=1.45 mA with typical VF. Low-current LED is chosen for visibility without large GPIO load.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Check actual current and behavior while transmitting; select exact resistor.

purpose: Probe Teensy-derived ADC logic supply.
value_basis: 2 mm pad exposes +3V3. This rail is separate from +3V3_RF; its ADC/pull-up allocation is less than 10 mA, to be measured.
status: Fabricated probe; author-chosen geometry
verification: Verify no two regulator outputs are joined and analog/digital sequencing remains within input limits.

purpose: Acquisition, SD logging, telemetry and command processor.
value_basis: Owner-selected Teensy 4.1. SPI0 D11/D12/D13, CS10/DRDY9; SPI1 D26/D1/D27, CS0/DRDY2. Radio uses documented Serial3 TX14/RX15/CTS19, RTS18. Serial 2 CTS on formerD14 was unsupported and is corrected. All I/O3.3 V.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Use Serial3.begin(115200), attachCts(19), attachRts(18); verify buffers, timing, SD peaks and reset defaults. Official UART page is cited separately.

purpose: Relay flyback diode.
value_basis: Semtech1N4148WS: cathode 1 to+5V,anode 2 tocoil_low. Initial coil current~46 mA is below 150 mA average datasheet rating; VFmax 1 V at 50 mA implies clamp near 6.17 V, below 30 V MOSFET rating. Coil energy/repetition/release delay still require testing.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify PCB placement, temperature, startup and measured behavior within the stated design assumptions.

purpose: Electronics 4S / separateignition 2S battery connectors.
value_basis: XT30PW-F selected drawings/5mmpowerpitch. Input J1return isGND;J4return is IGN_GND. Pad 2 is positive and pad 1 is return, matching the assigned KiCad footprint +/- markings. Connector family 15 A rating exceeds planning currents; mating gender/polarity and inconsistent retention-hole drawings require exact purchased-part fit verification.
status: Static choice checked; prototype qualification remains
verification: Do not use genericcatalog dimensions interchangeably with V 1.2; verify harness/polarity and external fuse.

purpose: External physical ARM switch loop.
value_basis: Exact green single-pitch WJ500V-5.08-2P-14-00A. Manufacturer drawingA specifies 5.08 mm pitch and 1.50 mm finishedholes. Imported pads already had 5.08 pitch despite 5.00 name, but 1.30 mm drills differed. New local footprint uses 1.50 mm drills/3 mm pads. UL10 A/300 V contact rating exceeds assumed 2 A/8.4 V.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify purchased drawingrevision, screw access/0.4Nm torque/6-7 mm strip, actual fit and series ARM switch.

purpose: PCB-mount ignition output in the chosenXT60 family.
value_basis: XT60PW-F replaces wire-termination XT60-F with a defined horizontal PCB part. V 1.2 installation drawing matches 7.20 mm powerpitch/2.70 mm holes and 13.5 mm retention-slot separation/6 mm setback. Pad 2 is switched positive, pad 1 is IGN_GND, matching footprint +/- markings. Newer catalog body dimensions differ; order/fit must be verified.
status: Static choice checked; prototype qualification remains

purpose: Normally-open relay contact in the separate ignition path.
value_basis: HF46F-G/5-HS1T: local pad IDs1/6 for coil and 2/3 for NO contacts; Hongfa type 1 bottom-view drawing verifies topology/coordinates but does not number the terminals;5 V/125 Ohm +/-10%. status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Qualify real current, duration, temperature, contact release/faults and physical footprint with a dummy load; nolive-load acceptance.

purpose: Low-side relay-coil switch.
value_basis: AO3400A is specified up to 48 mOhm RDS(on) at VGS=2.5 V, below the nominal 3.0 V drive. VGS(th) alone is not used to claim full turn-on.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Confirm exact manufacturer/package, pulse/current/thermal and reset/fault behavior; it does not switch the ignition load directly.

purpose: Limits MOSFET gate charge current/edge speed.
value_basis: 1 kOhm plus 10 kOhm pull-down forms a DC divider: VGS approximately 3.3*10/11=3.0 V. Value is an engineering choice, not an AO3400A requirement.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Check MCU VOH, transition time, gate leakage and brownout; GPIO supplies ~0.30 mA steady when high.

purpose: Keeps the MOSFET off with a floating MCU output.
value_basis: 10 kOhm discharges the gate and overcomes leakage. Together with R60 it reduces the driven gate voltage to about 3.0 V.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify actual GPIO reset states and noise immunity; a resistor cannot defeat a stuck-high output.

purpose: Probe relay drain/coil-low signal.
value_basis: 2 mm pad helps verify commanded ON/OFF, flyback and reset behavior with a dummy load. It is not a current measurement.
status: Fabricated probe; author-chosen geometry
verification: Use safe probing relative to electronics GND; confirm no accidental bridge to IGN_GND.

purpose: Buck input switching-current reservoir.

status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Place at VIN/GND; confirm effective C, input RMS current (~0.5 A at 1 A output worst duty) and hot-plug behavior.

purpose: High-frequency buck VIN bypass.

status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains

purpose: Bootstrap supply between the floating gate-driver pins.

status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify PCB placement, temperature, startup and measured behavior within the stated design assumptions.

purpose: Buck output charge reservoir and ripple filtering.

purpose: Blocks reverse battery polarity in normal DC use.
value_basis: SS54 is a 40 V / 5 A SMA rectifier in the retained MDD sheet. 40 V exceeds 16.8 V DC; transient and thermal margins remain unqualified. P=I*VF.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Confirm actual manufacturer; measure input surge, reverse faults and temperature at worst load.

purpose: Clamps positive input transients after reverse protection.
value_basis: Unidirectional SMBJ18A-13-F:18 V stand-off exceeds 16.8 V;29.2 V maximum clamp at 20.5 A specified 10/1000us pulse is below LMR36 V operating/38 V abs max and 50 V capacitors. These pulse conditions do not cover every possible cable surge.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Cathode 1 toVBAT, anode 2 GND. External fuse mandatory; verify hot-plug waveform and temperature derating.

purpose: Reduces switching-noise coupling into analog 5 V.
value_basis: BLM21PG601SN1D is 600 Ohm at 100 MHz, not DC. Initial DCRmax 0.14 Ohm gives 8.4 mV at 60 mA;0.20 Ohm post-test bound gives 12 mV. Current rating has ample margin for 60 mA. No ADC noise attenuation is inferred from the 100 MHz rating.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify actual analog supply noise/resonance and PCB return paths.

purpose: Electronics 4S / separateignition 2S battery connectors.
value_basis: XT30PW-F selected drawings/5mmpowerpitch. Input J1return isGND;J4return is IGN_GND. Pad 2 is positive and pad 1 is return, matching the assigned KiCad footprint +/- markings. Connector family 15 A rating exceeds planning currents; mating gender/polarity and inconsistent retention-hole drawings require exact purchased-part fit verification.

purpose: Stores switching energy between SW and 5 V.
value_basis: SRP1038A-3R3M:3.3uH +/-20%,11.8 mOhm maxDCR,Irms 11 A/Isat 20 A at 25C. TI1.1 MHz/5 V table uses 3.3uH. At16.8 V, Lmin 2.64uH/fmin 0.95 MHz gives 1.40 A p-p and 1.70 A peak at 1 A output, below IC min peak limit 3.67 A.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Check hot inductance/loss and switching layout; this physically large inductor favors margin over compactness.

purpose: Upper enable divider.
value_basis: 511k with 105k gives EN about 1.93 V at assumed 11.3 V protected input, above 1.36 V max rising threshold. The 1% limits and 200nA EN source current keep startup safely below normal 12 V battery operation. Divider is not a4S battery cutoff.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify PCB placement, temperature, startup and measured behavior within the stated design assumptions.

purpose: Lower enable divider.
value_basis: 105k completes the 511k/105k divider. Nominal rising threshold 1.227*(1+511/105)=7.20 V before EN source current; normal input 12-16.8 V is comfortably above this. External battery undervoltage protection is required.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify PCB placement, temperature, startup and measured behavior within the stated design assumptions.

purpose: Sets the main 5 V feedback ratio.
value_basis: R3=100k and R4=13.7k, both 0.1%/25 ppm/K. Include R5=49.9 Ohm: VOUT=0.600*(1+100049.9/13700)=4.98175 V. TI0.591-0.609 V reference, resistor tolerances and conservative +/-50nA FB bias give 4.89337-5.07041 V DC.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify DC voltage at the load and ≤0.10 V transient screen; include distribution drop before accepting ADS1256 supply/reference windows.

purpose: Sets the main 5 V feedback ratio.

purpose: Control-loop injection break point in feedback sensing.
value_basis: 49.9 Ohm is retained as a small series loop-test resistor. Its DC contribution to the upper feedback leg is included. C9 feed-forward is removed because the new regulator example does not require the old 75 pF network.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify PCB placement, temperature, startup and measured behavior within the stated design assumptions.

purpose: Probe protected battery and regulated 5 V.
value_basis: 2 mm pad is a probing/assembly choice, not an electrical datasheet requirement. TP1 should show protected VBAT; TP2 about 4.981 V unloaded nominal.

verification: Check probe access/clearance; measure load and startup waveforms without shorting adjacent nodes.

purpose: Probe protected battery and regulated 5 V.

purpose: Converts protected 4S power to the main 5 V rail.
value_basis: LMR51430YFDDCR is the 1.1 MHz FPWM DDC6 order. Frequency minimum 0.95 MHz exceeds Digi 500 kHz recommendation; 4.5-36 V operation covers protected 11.3-16.8 V. Board planning limit remains 1 A. Pin 1GND/2SW/3 VIN/4FB/5EN/6CB.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Verify actual 5 V/load steps and temperature; no 3 A board rating follows from this IC.

purpose: Provides an independent 3.3 V supply for the XBee.
value_basis: TLV75533PDBVR is the fixed 3.3 V DBV package. At 100 mA, (4.981-3.3)*0.1 is about 0.168 W. The 500 mA IC rating is not this board's qualified output.
status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
verification: Check DBV thermal resistance/copper, dropout, inrush, output discharge and RF ripple.

purpose: Low-frequency pressure filter at buffered divider.

status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains

status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains

status: Static choice checked; PCB/bench qualification remains
